facts.fact: The company is located at 1200 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701.
The offer letter is dated 10 November 2026.
The offered position is Founding Engineer.
The base salary is $120,000 per year.
The salary is paid twice a month.
The candidate will be granted options to purchase 0.75% of the fully diluted shares.
The equity vests over 4 years.
The equity has a 1-year cliff.
If the candidate leaves before their first anniversary, no options vest.
The start date is 4 January 2027.
The role is based in the Austin, Texas office.
The role is hybrid, requiring being in the office at least 3 days per week.
The company offers a $10,000 relocation stipend.
Weeks of 50 to 60 hours are common during launches.
Lumen Labs raised a $2.1M seed round in March 2026.
The current burn is $150,000 per month.
The company has about 14 months of runway.
Health, dental and vision insurance are provided from day one.
The company offers unlimited paid time off.
The offer expires on 21 November 2026.
